language.label: Language
language.error: Could not change the language. Please try again.
language.unsavedHint: Save or cancel your changes to switch the language.

profile.title: {name}'s details
profile.description: Manage how your information appears to others on the platform.
profile.bioPlaceholder: Describe your interests and what you want to try

avatar.title: Profile picture
avatar.hint: Supports JPG, PNG, GIF, or WebP. Max 4 MB.

bio.hint: Your bio tells the AI what ideas to create. Describe your interests, hobbies, work and what you want to try. The more specific it is, the better your deck.

security.title: Security
security.description: Manage your password, authentication, and account lifecycle.
security.passwordDescription: Update the password associated with your account.
security.passwordHint: Secure passwords help protect your data.
security.twoFactorDescription: Add an extra layer of security to your account by requiring a verification code from an authenticator app upon login.
security.twoFactorHint: We highly recommend enabling this feature.
security.deleteDescription: Permanently remove your account and all of its contents from the Swiipy platform. This action is not reversible, so please continue with caution.

deleteAccount.googleHint: You signed in with Google, so no password is needed. If your last sign-in was more than a day ago, we will ask you to sign in again.
deleteAccount.reauthRequired: Please sign in again to delete your account
deleteAccount.reauthReason: For your safety, account deletion needs a recent sign-in.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Decide what Swiipy may send to {email}.
notifications.emailDescription: Choose which emails Swiipy sends you.

securityEmails.title: Security emails
securityEmails.description: Password resets, email changes and verification links. They keep your account safe, so they cannot be turned off.

productUpdates.title: Product updates
productUpdates.description: News about new features, like personalized picks in For you. Sent rarely.

weeklyDigest.title: Weekly digest
weeklyDigest.description: A short weekly summary of the ideas you saved and a nudge to swipe a fresh deck.

notifications.optionalHint: Optional emails are only sent if you turn them on.
